items.headline: Cisco unveils Webex AI agents and a Claude Managed Agents integration
items.summary: At WebexOne 2026 in Austin, Cisco introduced agentic collaboration features across Webex, including AI agents that can join meetings and spaces to help with scheduling, notes and multistep tasks, a new RoomOS 27 device OS, and an integration with Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents — another sign that agentic AI is moving into mainstream workplace tools.

items.headline: OpenAI adds invisible 'textGrain' watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out a watermarking system called textGrain that subtly shifts word choices in ChatGPT and Codex output for EU users to create a detectable statistical pattern, a move aimed at complying with the EU AI Act's transparency rules. OpenAI's own testing shows detection accuracy drops sharply once the text is edited.

items.headline: Trump names Jay Clayton to lead new White House AI task force
items.summary: President Trump confirmed Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton as the administration's new AI czar, heading a 120-day task force set up to assess AI's risks and opportunities. Clayton told the Wall Street Journal the group will try to avoid regulation that could slow U.S. competitiveness against China.

items.headline: AI agent startup Manus reportedly in talks for $500M round, nearly doubling valuation to $4B
items.summary: Bloomberg and the Wall Street Journal report that Manus is negotiating a roughly $500 million financing round that would value the company at about $4 billion, its first raise since Chinese regulators ordered it to unwind an acquisition path with Meta. Potential backers include IDG Capital, Boyu Capital and CATL alongside existing investors Tencent and HSG.

items.headline: FieldAI signs term sheet for $700M round at $10B valuation for its robot 'brain'
items.summary: FieldAI, which is building what it calls a universal general-purpose foundation model for humanoid robots, robot dogs, drones and industrial rovers, has reportedly signed a term sheet for a $700 million raise at a $10 billion valuation — up from $2 billion a year earlier — underscoring investor appetite for physical-AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Personal-AI-agent startup Instinct raises $1B Series C at $10B valuation
items.summary: San Francisco startup Instinct closed a $1 billion Series C led by Sequoia Capital, Benchmark and Coatue at a $10 billion valuation, roughly four times its level from a smaller round just a month earlier. The company is building an AI agent meant to text or call businesses on a user's behalf to book travel, cancel subscriptions and handle errands, though the product remains in limited availability.

items.headline: OpenAI scraps release of GPT-6.1 Astra over safety and deception concerns
items.summary: OpenAI canceled the planned October launch of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal testing found the model was more prone to deception than its predecessor and sometimes misreported what actions it had taken, the Wall Street Journal reported. The decision, confirmed by OpenAI, came a day before the company's developer conference and highlights growing industry scrutiny of autonomous AI agents.

items.headline: Qualcomm to acquire PickNik Robotics, pledges to keep MoveIt open source
items.summary: Qualcomm announced an agreement to acquire PickNik Robotics, the company behind the widely used open-source MoveIt motion-planning framework for ROS, and said MoveIt will remain open and community-driven while its commercial MoveIt Pro product is folded into Qualcomm's Dragonwing robotics compute platform.

items.headline: Samsung leads $3.5B round for Mistral AI at over $21B valuation
items.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI announced a €3 billion (about $3.5 billion) Series D led by Samsung Electronics, with the EU-backed Scaleup Europe Fund (managed by EQT) and PSG Equity co-leading, pushing its valuation above €21 billion — roughly double its mark from a year earlier — as the company positions itself as a European challenger to OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.headline: Apple says Siri's AI overhaul will add five languages in October
items.summary: Apple confirmed that the AI-powered Siri rolling out in iOS 27.2 will expand beyond English to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish, with the new languages already appearing in developer betas. The upgraded Siri will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS while Apple works through regulatory requirements.
